_what: Commencement of statute provisions that are enacted but not yet in force, as RECORDED by the ratified Legal Constitution L1.10 §28.2. Statutory text is not commencement: the India Code print of the DPDP Act holds s. 33 and the Schedule verbatim, with nothing saying they are not yet operative.
_source: docs/02-legal-domain/LEGAL_CONSTITUTION_L1.10.md §28.2 — every `quote` below is sliced from it verbatim (test_statute_commencement.py). The Gazette commencement notification itself is NOT in the supplied source material.
_scope: Only provisions the Constitution names by number. Tranche 3's 'substantive Data Fiduciary/Data Processor obligations (notice, consent, …)' are described, not numbered; mapping them to sections would be inventing law (rule 7), so they carry no record here.
